executive_summary.question: Does Trainable HiGS exhibit meaningful and increasing training-time advantage over conventional gsplat as scene density, resolution, and camera workload scale?
executive_summary.answer: NO - speedup is FLAT across workload, but consistent ~13-16% architectural advantage exists
executive_summary.primary_contribution: Native backward enabling end-to-end differentiation of hierarchical renderer, NOT workload-dependent scaling

strengths: Consistent 13-18% speedup across all tested workloads (S_FB 1.14-1.20x)
Backward efficiency is robust and well-understood (elimination of indexing_backward)
limitations: Speedup does NOT increase with workload (H1 refuted)
No point achieves S_FB >= 1.20x required for GO_TRAINABLE_HIGS_DENSE_WORKLOAD_PAPER
Forward is at parity; advantage is entirely from backward
Memory usage is slightly HIGHER for HiGS (dual representation)
Tile LOD potential not realized (would require substantial rework)
verdict_rationale.why_not_GO_TRAINABLE_HIGS_PAPER: Speedup is modest (~13-16%), not the 'clear' (>20%) implied by GO verdict; quality-neutral but not quality-improving on frozen path
verdict_rationale.why_not_GO_TRAINABLE_HIGS_DENSE_WORKLOAD: No workload-scaling trend; speedup is FLAT, not strong/reliable at high N with clear trend
verdict_rationale.why_not_NO_GO: Consistent 13-16% speedup is scientifically meaningful and reproducible; architectural contribution (native backward) is valuable
verdict_rationale.why_inVESTIGATE: Speedup is real but modest; scaling hypothesis (H1) not supported; needs further investigation of tile LOD potential and HiGS-format backward to determine if larger speedup is achievable

evidence_summary.correctness: PASS - 100 tests, gradient cosine 0.999996-1.000000, quality parity within noise
evidence_summary.memory: HiGS uses +0.75 GB (HIGH-N), not an advantage

hypothesis_evaluation.H1_scaling_with_workload: REFUTED - speedup is FLAT, not increasing
hypothesis_evaluation.H2_backward_dominates: SUPPORTED - forward at parity, backward provides all speedup
hypothesis_evaluation.H3_topology_overhead_erases: REFUTED - dynamic topology amplifies advantage via densify/prune
hypothesis_evaluation.H4_culling_dependent: WEAKLY_REFUTED - higher culling does not increase speedup

architectural_contribution: Native CUDA backward kernels consuming forward-captured state
Direct scatter to master rows (no index_copy_)
Versioned scene binding for dynamic topology

comparison_to_prior_work.this_work: Enables end-to-end training of HiGS via native backward
comparison_to_prior_work.closest_prior_work: Taming 3DGS (visible Adam), Speedy-Splat (sparse gradients), but neither enables hierarchical renderer training

recommended_paper_position.title: Trainable HiGS: End-to-End Differentiation of Hierarchical Gaussian Splatting
recommended_paper_position.claim: We enable end-to-end training of HiGS hierarchical renderer via native CUDA backward, achieving consistent 13-16% speedup over standard gsplat across diverse workloads
recommended_paper_position.scope: Quality-neutral frozen path + quality-improving dynamic path (densify/prune)
recommended_paper_position.limitations_ack: Speedup is modest; forward at parity; tile LOD potential not realized
recommended_paper_position.future_work: HiGS-format backward consuming macro-tile structure (30M vs 330M isects)

reviewer_safe_claims: Trainable HiGS native provides 13-18% training speedup (S_FB 1.14-1.20x) over conventional gsplat
Speedup is consistent across scene density (1M-6M Gaussians), resolution (540p-1080p), and camera batch (B1-B4)
Advantage comes from backward efficiency (elimination of indexing_backward), not forward culling
Quality is neutral on frozen path (PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS within 0.01 dB / 0.0005)
Dynamic topology with densify/prune amplifies speedup (1.32-1.63x at 20 steps) via N reduction
claims_to_avoid: HiGS scales better with workload (FALSE - FLAT)
Hierarchical rendering provides speedup (FALSE - forward at parity)
HiGS reduces memory (FALSE - uses +0.75 GB for HIGH-N)
Speedup increases with scene complexity (FALSE - FLAT)
We invented HiGS (FALSE - HiGS is prior work)

next_actions.medium_term: Investigate tile LOD feasibility (HiGS-format backward consuming macro-tile structure)
next_actions.long_term: If tile LOD realized, re-benchmark to see if speedup increases to 1.5-2x
